'''Ervyn''' was an individual who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Prakith/Legends|Prakith]] during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. In c. [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]], the [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Jekk Seejo]] encountered trouble near Prakith, when [[Good Feeling|his starship]] was attacked by [[Mynock/Legends|mynocks]]. A group of [[Alderaanian Resistance]] agents contacted [[Prak City Control]] to request that they be given permission to rescue Seejo, and the Prak City controller informed Ervyn that Seejo had wrecked a starship again.<ref name="Sword of the Empire" />
